contracts.commit_point: ingest_pdf(context.pdf_bytes) at tools.py:80, whose external write commits at PineconeVectorStore.from_documents(...) (ingest.py:58-63); within the same guarded flow, index creation can additionally commit at _ensure_pinecone_index / pc.create_index (ingest.py:17-26, invoked at ingest.py:55).
contracts.declared_mechanism: Pre-commit refusal guards inside the @tool index_document: early return when context.indexed is true (tools.py:63-69) and when context.index_count >= MAX_INDEX_CALLS (tools.py:70-76); MAX_INDEX_CALLS = 1 is defined in context.py:7 and the flag/counter live on AgentContext (context.py:18,23). The counter is incremented before the effect (tools.py:78) and decremented on exception so a failed attempt may be retried (tools.py:88).
contracts.forbidden_condition: A second execution of the indexing effect after the document is already indexed (context.indexed == True) or after the one-call budget is exhausted (context.index_count >= MAX_INDEX_CALLS with MAX_INDEX_CALLS = 1), i.e., any repeat index_document invocation that would re-run ingest_pdf and re-write the PDF chunks to Pinecone.
pending_binding_information: Reviewer wording 'per session' presumes AgentContext is created once per session; the creating code (session_manager) is outside the supplied views, so only per-context-instance scope is evidenced.
The @tool decorator and the returned tool list establish tool registration; the LangGraph agent node that actually dispatches these tools at runtime is not in the supplied views.

Whether the side-effecting index creation _ensure_pinecone_index (ingest.py:17-26) should be tracked as its own commit point contract; it commits in the same database stratum under the same guard, so it is folded into this contract pending reviewer guidance.
contracts.protected_operation: Agent invocation of the index_document tool that performs indexing of the uploaded PDF (tools.py index_document -> ingest_pdf(context.pdf_bytes), then binding context.retriever and setting context.indexed).
contracts.protected_resource: External Pinecone vector store: index config.PINECONE_INDEX_NAME, per-PDF namespace derived as sha256(pdf_bytes)[:16] (ingest.py:29-30), holding the chunk embeddings of the uploaded PDF.
contracts.protection_obligation: Merged from both reviewers: the agent tool index_document must refuse re-indexing — returning a refusal when context.indexed is already true or when context.index_count >= MAX_INDEX_CALLS (= 1) — so that the external Pinecone write performed by ingest_pdf / PineconeVectorStore.from_documents commits at most once per session (once per AgentContext/tool-set instance).
scope_limits: Guarantee is scoped to the AgentContext instance passed to create_agent_tools (tools.py:31); no cross-session or cross-process deduplication is shown, and no idempotency check on an existing namespace is shown (namespace is content-derived, ingest.py:29-30).
Because a failed attempt decrements index_count (tools.py:88), at-most-once applies to committed writes; exactly one new attempt is permitted after each failure.
Guards return JSON refusal payloads to the model rather than raising; only the tool execution path is constrained, and only callers via this tool closure are shown.
No supplied code path resets context.indexed after success, so the post-success refusal is permanent for the context lifetime.
Same commit point and same stratum; the search-budget, validate, reject, and ask_human count guards in the same file are distinct mechanisms not merged into this contract.

contracts.commit_point: docs = context.retriever.invoke(query) at tools.py:118 — the outbound retrieval query to the Pinecone-backed store.
contracts.declared_mechanism: Precondition guard inside the @tool search_documents: early string refusal when context.retriever is None (tools.py:108-109). A separate MAX_SEARCH_CALLS = 6 budget guard (tools.py:111-115, context.py:8) caps total searches but is not the obligation compiled here.
contracts.forbidden_condition: Executing the retrieval (context.retriever.invoke(query)) before index_document has completed and set context.retriever, i.e., search_documents invoked while context.retriever is None ('Document is not indexed yet').
pending_binding_information: Whether search_documents is dispatched by the LangGraph agent loop and whether queries originate from model output — tool registration is evidenced (@tool decorator, returned list), but the runtime dispatch path is not in the supplied views.
Whether read-only vector-store queries should be tracked under a database stratum instead of http; compiled as http (network API request effect) because the query mutates nothing.
contracts.protected_operation: Agent invocation of the search_documents tool performing retrieval over the indexed PDF (tools.py search_documents -> context.retriever.invoke(query)).
contracts.protected_resource: The Pinecone-backed VectorStoreRetriever bound on AgentContext.retriever after indexing (context.py:16), targeting the per-PDF namespace of config.PINECONE_INDEX_NAME.
contracts.protection_obligation: From the first reviewer: the agent tool search_documents must refuse retrieval before indexing has bound a retriever — when context.retriever is None it must return a refusal instead of executing context.retriever.invoke(query) against the Pinecone store.
scope_limits: Classified as http because the retrieval is a non-mutating network/API request to the Pinecone service; it is not a persistent database mutation.
Guard is scoped to the AgentContext instance passed to create_agent_tools (tools.py:31); session-level lifetime is not shown in supplied views.
The precondition only verifies that a retriever object is bound; it does not verify namespace contents beyond the assignment at tools.py:81-82.
The MAX_SEARCH_CALLS budget refusal (tools.py:111-115) is a separate rate-limit mechanism, not merged into this obligation.
The refusal is a plain string response to the model; only the tool execution path is constrained.
